Product Features

  • Modern, minimalist TV cabinet design that integrates effortlessly into different home styles.
  • With the total dimensions of 180×40×45 cm, the spacious surface offers space for large TVs and decorative items.
  • Combined with two drawers and two doors, it allows for organized storage and eliminates clutter in the living room.
  • Made of high-quality chipboard material, the cabinet is stable and durable with a recommended load capacity of 75kg.
  • The wood-colored geometric lines give the room a natural texture and stylish design.
  • The thin black legs lift the cabinet slightly and make it easy to clean the floor underneath.
  • Hidden storage compartments provide space for remote controls, game consoles, books and other utensils.
  • The matt black surface in combination with the wood look is timeless and creates a cosy living room atmosphere.
  • Easy to assemble with clear instructions to effortlessly create a tidy living space.
  • Due to light and monitor settings, the actual color of the product may be slightly different from the picture. The article received is decisive.
